$comment: Hand-written from 13 FM-068 and 15 §6 C-11 (INV-38): after its first record the CLI changed its format (the record type field renamed); each record of the new format is skipped with one warning and nothing of it is read. Shared by format-changed-crlf.jsonl. The observation loop's case (ISSUE-084) replays the drifted records one poll at a time.
